hero.title: Promo Modal pattern
hero.description: A dismissible promo popup that opens on the home page after a short delay, for a time-limited offer or announcement — never a full events/news system, just one flyer image plus an optional headline, body and CTA.

example.title: Example
example.description: Click "Reopen example" to preview the popup — in a real site it opens on its own shortly after the home page loads, showing the soonest-expiring eligible promo. Dismissing it (the × or clicking outside) remembers the choice in localStorage until the promo's own end date.

example.imageAlt: Back to School Special flyer — 20% off all services for new clients in September
example.headline: Back to School Special: 20% off for new clients!
example.body: Book any service during September and save 20% off all services.

standard.title: Standard
standard.oneAtATime: Shows at most one promo at a time — the soonest-expiring eligible entry from the `promos` array, never a stack of popups.
standard.dateWindow: `startsAtIso`/`expiresAtIso` gate eligibility: not shown before its start date, never shown again once expired.
standard.dismiss: Dismissal persists per promo id in localStorage (`${storageKeyPrefix}_${id}`), the same convention EventBanner uses — keyed to the promo's own `expiresAtIso`, so a dismissed promo only comes back if it's re-dated or replaced.
standard.homeOnly: Home page only, by fleet convention — same rule as EventBanner. Never also render it on other pages.
standard.plainStrings: Plain-string props only, no i18n inside the component — a bilingual site resolves `LocalizedText` to a plain string per language before building the `promos` array, same as every other shared pattern.
